name: Liverpool warehouse clearance
description: An old building in south Liverpool to knock down and replace. Demolition first, then build.
attribution: Terrain: Terrain Tiles (AWS Open Data / Mapzen), including data from SRTM, GMTED2010, ETOPO1, EU-DEM (Copernicus) and national LIDAR sources

licence.note: Derived from OpenStreetMap data, available under the Open Database Licence. Show '© OpenStreetMap contributors' wherever this site is used.

axes: metres; x east, y up, z south (-z is north); y = 0 is the plot's mean ground level

terrain.encoding: float32le, row-major, rows run +z (north to south), columns run +x (west to east)

factors.label: Neighbours close to the boundary
factors.detail: 2 building(s) within 6 m of the boundary, the nearest right on it (party wall or shared boundary). Needs careful excavation, scaffolding and demolition.

factors.label: No road frontage
factors.detail: No vehicle road touches the plot (nearest 9 m away). Deliveries and cranes need a temporary haul road or a lift over neighbours.

factors.label: Existing buildings to clear
factors.detail: 1 building(s) (604 m2 of footprint) stand on the plot and must be demolished and cleared first.

factors.label: Made ground
factors.detail: Previously developed land: buried foundations, fill and possible contamination. Trial pits recommended.
